verdict.rationale: Mastra Code documents some long-running autonomy: Goals keep it working across turns until a judge model marks the objective complete, and it has built-in Explore/Plan/Execute subagents. Headless `runMC` can be embedded in servers, but that is a building block for orchestration, not fleet management. Nothing in the evidence shows launching parallel fleets of agents on separate tasks, or runs lasting hours or days. Missing for 10: documented parallel multi-agent fleet launching and management, evidence of hours- or days-long unattended runs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can launch fleets of autonomous agents that work in parallel on different tasks for hours or days

citations.quote: Keep Mastra Code working across turns until a judge model marks the objective complete or waits for your input.
